book.name: Jon
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Jon kaavu

content: Yesu tu hees wain keen
“Sak sa hees wain keen, de Mangg ond yik kul wain dangga yi.

+ o 15:2 Mat 3:10*Om sa namangg sen me-nayiis nôôn-ato ond Mangg navu katôôv vêêl-ambe naate la, tonde sa namangg sen nayiis nôôn-ato ond Mangg navu katôôv ngaaho be natongin in nambe nyiis nôôn ngeeyaata lôôt.
+ o 15:3 Jon 13:10*De ham ond vakasin sen saanêêl vu ham-ato wiing-ambe ham anim vasa lak lung la.

+ o 15:4 Jon 6:56*Ham oo mando dôôk sa longgpayo ond mem sale mando dôôk ham alompayo. Le naambe ham-ame mando dôôk sa le, ond ham-ame alohvu nambe anyiis nôôn e, manyinja lohvu hees wain nama sen me-naale lak jêês-ato le, ond me-le nyiis nôôn e.

+ o 15:5 Jon 15:16; 1Ko 12:12,27; 2Ko 3:5*“Ke, hees wain sa, de nama ham. Omaaho ti sen nando hôôk sa de sa nando hôôk yii-to, ond le nyiis nôôn ngeeyaata lôôt. De naambe same mando dôôk ham e, ond ham-ame alohvu nambe ambiing vati le.
+ o 15:6 Mat 7:19; 13:42*Tonde omaaho ti me-mando dôôk sa le, ond le na menama naambe hees nama sen davu katôôv vêêl-ambe navu bambôôv-ato, tonde dasupin-ambe lala daate lakala kin-ambe kin naya.
+ o 15:7 Mat 7:7; Jon 14:13; 16:23*Nambe ham mando dôôk sa, de sate vakasin mando dôôk ham, tombe ham akam wiingin vati be ham kataangg, ond le nôôn jak vu ham.
+ o 15:8 Mat 5:16*Naambe ham anyiis nôôn ngeeyaata ond mem Mangg haale le naatu bop jak, tonde nôôn ngeeyaataa-ja taato nambe ham atu sate hil.
Sahengg having ham nambe sen Mangg ahe having saa-to, om ham mando dôôk sate ahe havingin-anja lopayo.
+ o 15:10 Jon 14:15; 1Jon 2:5*Tonde ham samu sate tanasin, ond ham e mando dôôk sate ahe havingin alopayo naambe sen sa navu taamuyin Mangg-ate tanasin tombe sa nando hôôk yite ahe havingin alopayo.
+ o 15:11 Jon 17:13*“Saanêêl vakasin pin-anja laas vu ham in nambe sa kangg vasaa-to ond dukanaas ham alompayo in ham oo naapêêlis lôôt.
+ o 15:12 Jon 13:34*De sate tanasin-anjo nambe ham ahem gaving mango-so naambe sen sahengg having ham-ato.
+ o 15:13 Jon 10:11; Lom 5:8; 1Jon 3:16*Tonde omaaho ti jimb in dôôvu yite hil ond yite ahe havingin savok hil pin-ate ahend havingin la.
+ o 15:14 Mat 12:50*De naambe ham ambiing nohvu saanêêl vu ham-ato, ond sate hil ham.

De same le naanêêl ham jesin naah naambe sate hil kul vaha-so ham e, in hil kul vaha-so ond sil doosin kul sen silate yêêv nawiing-ato. Nganjo saanêêl ham nambe ham atu sate hil keen, in va pin sen sa nango neep vu Mangg-ato ond manyinja saanêêl langaah vu ham lung la.

+ o 15:16 Jon 15:5; 16:23*Ham-ame aholin sa lak e, nganjo saaholin ham ak-ambe saawiing ham ala in nambe ham ana anyiis nôôn, tombe hamate nôôn-anja mando danggata. Tonde ham kataangg vati lak sa haalengg vu Mangg ond le bu naas vu ham.
+ o 15:17 Jon 13:34*Sate tanasin-anjo nambe ham ahem gaving ham.”
Hil voon le lambiing ngaamong vu Yesu-te hil
+ o 15:18 Mat 10:22; 1Jon 3:13*“Naambe hil voon anind baya lôôt in ham ond ham akam bu sen sil oo nind baya lôôt in sa munggin-ato.

+ o 15:19 1; Jon 4:5; Jon 17:14*Le naambe hil voon-ate ham ond sil ahend e gaving ham in ham dangga timu. Nganjo hil voon-ame silate ham e, malis, in saaholin ham vu sil lavuun lung la, ondeey hil voon anind baya lôôt in ham.

+ o 15:20 Jon 13:16*Tonde ham akam bu vakasin sen saanêêl vu ham nambe kul vaha me-savok yite yêêv-ato le, om sen hil voon dawiing nindanjeen vu sa ond le lambiing nindanjeen vu ham gaving. Nambe sil taamuyin sate vakasin ond sil e taamuyin hamate vakasin gaving.
+ o 15:21 Mat 5:11; Mak 13:13; Jon 16:3*Lemu omaahonôôn e lambiing nindanjeen vu ham in sate hil ham, in me-lalak omaaho sen wiing sa be sa laam-ato ni le.

De nambe same anaam naanêêl vakasin langaah vu sil e, ond sil-ame le galuuh damind vu sa de va nipaya me-nanjip vu sil e. Le ma de sa laam-ambe saanêêl vu sil-ande laluuh damind vu sa, om gêên sil-ame lalohvu nambe lanjak alund in silate nipaya le.
+ o 15:23 Luk 10:16*Tonde omaaho ti nambe nimbaya in sa ond manyinja nimbaya in Mangg having.

+ o 15:24 Jon 9:41; 14:11*De kul vaha vaha sen omaaho ti me-wiing bôôy-ato, nambe same anaam-ambe saambiing-ambe lanji le tombe sil galuuh damind vu sa, ond va nipaya me-le nanjip vu sil e. Nganjo gêên layi lung la, tombe nind baya lôôt in haay ahondoos Mangg.
+ o 15:25 Saam 35:19; 69:4*Nambêênja in vakasin sen Anutu-te hil kaavu be neep hôôk yate tanasin-ato nôôn jak naambe, ‘Nind baya lôôt in sa malis amu de dangga ma.’

+ o 15:26 Jon 14:26*Ke, tonde Omaaho Samusamu nando having Mangg, tombe sale aambiing naam vu ham, yik Vavi Vaambuung sen nanêêl vakasin keen-ato ond yoo le vu Mangg-ambe naam naanêêl sate vakasin langaah vu ham.
+ o 15:27 Luk 1:2; Sin 1:8,21-22*Tonde ham e tatekin sate dangga langaah gaving, in ham oo nando having sa bôôy-ambe tok laam gêên-anjo.
